en: A non-arisen state is not a condition, by way of root-condition, for an arisen state.
A non-arising state is not a condition, by way of root-condition, for an arisen state. Non-arisen and non-arising states are conditions, by way of root-condition, for an arisen state. (Abbreviated.)

With respect to root condition: three; with respect to object and predominance conditions: seven; with respect to conascence, mutuality, and dependence conditions: three; with respect to strong-dependence condition: seven; with respect to prenascence and postnascence conditions: three ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance condition: three.
